integrity: Mathematical proof is self-contained; rational stationary checker provides finite corroboration, not an infinite proof. Historical novelty remains a same-model literature assessment subject to independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Exact stationary moments and the fixed-contrarian joint weak limit only; no assertion for increasing contrarian counts, alternative response rules, structured networks, transient mixing times, or a closed form for the full finite-state stationary mass function.
title: The fixed-contrarian beta law and exact finite-population fluctuations
